Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)

India
Checked 2026-08-14

The Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY) provides free food grains to India's poorest households. It serves Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) and Priority Households (PHH) beneficiaries across the country.

  • Food
CostFree with eligibility.

The program provides food grains free of cost to eligible beneficiaries.

AccessMonthly ration distribution
Open listing
Hours, location & verification
Coverage
Nationwide program covering all of India

Check before you go. Available to identified Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) and Priority Households (PHH) beneficiaries through Fair Price Shops.
